reviews.text: I like it a lot. I just need to use it more often. I think there is a way to repeat a practice and I need to use that because there are so many different poses that when I want to do it without a video, I don’t know where to start. Also, 👌🏻 music selection

Best Yoga App. This is the best yoga app I’ve ever used and quite possibly the best app I’ve ever used for anything. I’ve been with down dog for almost 10 years and I hope to be with the another 10 years or more. 1000% worth the investment.

Best Yoga App. Honestly this app is great. Such a good selection of practices when I am in need of a sweat, mobility or just relaxation. You can also choose the exact length of your practice and if you want to add a focus on a specific part of body for stretching or strengthening. 
The app it self is also very aesthetic and simple.

I love you. The ai paranoia is so stupid. People are straight up dumb… They’re so dumb they’ll probably think this comment is also ai. I’ve been using this app way before ai was widely used, and the voices and people are all real. This app goes above and beyond, and is super conscious about accessibility and health. Put some respect on Down Dog’s name!!!

Favorite yoga app. I have been doing down dog yoga for years. I appreciate how the routines change, and can be customized to what you want to work on. I also love the way it accommodates different time periods. I am busy parenting and working and I like being able to consistently do yoga even for a few
Minutes a day.
My favorite workout app. I have been using down dog for years now, and have logged hundreds of hours. I have never found another yoga app that comes close.

Have yet to find a better yoga app. I’ve tried more expensive yoga apps and I don’t get why they’re more expensive-this app is the best! Love that I can easily pause my practice to tend to little kids as needed :)

Used to be the best now a waste of time. I use this app all the time. Every single day until you changed it and now I can never get the app to load. I spend the entire time I have for yoga reloading the app and trying to get it to open. If I delete and reload it from the App Store three times it finally opens but really. I feel like it’s a waste of time and money now I will not be subscribing again and am looking for a more friendly app
Customize your daily routine. I’ve been using this app for years now. I love the easy customization and the ability to target particular area areas.
Amazing Yoga. Great way to practice self care from anywhere. Fully customizable yoga experience. Staff accommodates for financial needs.
What A Great Yoga App. You can’t ask for a more customizable yoga experience. Excellent!

Excellent. I love the Downdog Yoga app. I have used it for years. My favorite part is being able to fully customize my practice with duration, style of music, difficulty, and even choosing an area of focus.
really good. Just so good, customizable, easy. My favorite workout.

My favorite app. Easily my favorite app. I love that I can change the level, the time, and the type of yoga workout I want to do. I love that it also records if I do barre or Pilates. Worth every penny.

Been a member for 5 or 6 years now. I love this app. It targets different stretching groups and has the attached apps for versatility. I recommend this app to anyone engaged in their health and those seeking guidance. I love this app and I’m glad I found it.

Excellent app and tool. I have been using this app for months now and it truly is fantastic. I primarily use it to tack on maybe 15 minutes of yoga after cardio and weight workouts, and I love that it gives me variety every single time I do it, and that I can control the type of workout, the intensity and skill level. I recommend it to everybody whenever I have opportunity to bring it up in conversation.

Perfect!. Yoga has truly changed my life, and after trying many classes and apps, I found Down Dog. It’s by far the best. The instruction is excellent, and what makes it special is that it isn’t just about poses it also brings the mindfulness and calm that yoga is really about. If you’ve been thinking about starting yoga, do yourself a favor and start with Down Dog.

Best at Home Workout App. I started using Down Dog a few months ago, and my body already feels noticeably stronger and more flexible. I love that I can customize each workout based on how I’m feeling that day, which keeps my practice fresh and sustainable.

Recently I’ve started experimenting with the HIIT workouts, and I’m already noticing progress. Before Down Dog, I relied on signing up for gym classes because I wasn’t disciplined enough to work out consistently on my own. Now I have a home workout routine that I actually stick with.

The flexibility, variety, and quality of the workouts have made it much easier for me to stay consistent. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for an effective and adaptable fitness app.

Better than Therapy. Yoga has given so much and I recommend this anyone in every once that I can. I love that I can have a practice at my house at the park at the beach wherever is convenient for me. And I know that these yoga sessions helped to keep me away from painkillers and other medication’s. I was inspired by Kareem Abdul-Jabbar that playing for 20 seasons with practically no injuries and he stood at 7’2”
Beginner. Great way to start the day. Must do more of this … great options and love the time customization

Made me a yogi. I started using this app during COVID, having done one formal class. When I went to class a year later, I was one of the more advanced students. It truly gives you the core fundamentals of yoga. I now work in Wellness and prefer to use the app in nature than a studio and know i get a full practice including standing poses which is rare in person. I tell everyone who asks about my practice.
Fantastic Value. Love this app. The workouts are super flexible, the price is right. A must have app.

My Favorite Yoga Practice. I’ve been using this app on/off for 9 years. And it always gives me something to look forward to when I come for a yoga practice. 

The variations provide thousands of different practices, and adding enhancements gives it a more personal touch for your own practice. I love sharing this app with loved ones when they are open to a practice. Being able to set the difficulty and level of instruction, and having a video to follow, helps to find the correct posture for each pose. 

This app is a great accompaniment to a yoga class as well, so that you can start to remember the pose names and get to know what follows for each pose type. 

All in all, even when I take a break from yoga, I’m always happy to return back to this app. :) Namaste Down Dog
Customizable. I love that I can tell the app exactly what I want to focus on, and it will create something specifically focused on that. I feel so much better since I’ve been using it.

Great. Every day is a little different and you can customize the length and style of workout based on your mood and schedule. The poses can be eliminated if you don’t like them and the ones you do like can be incorporated more. Highly recommend! This is the longest I have stuck to an online/app based workout ever!
Personalizes to you. Pick the level of difficulty, pick the time of day, pick the focus and then thumb up or down your favorite poses. After a while you will have your favorite flow.
My favorite app. My favorite exercise app. Pick your type of yoga, pick the time you have, and get ready for a catered exercise that stretches your body and calms your soul.
I love the privacy of practicing at home.. I love being able to stretch, strengthen and relax without having to go anywhere.
Love this app!. I love how much you can customize your practice!
Favorite. This is the best yoga app. I have used it since the pandemic. The customization always helps meet my needs, and I go from feeling anxious or stiff to rejuvenated and light every time.
Wonderful app. I’ve been using this app for years! It’s constantly been getting better over the years! I love it! Very easy and straightforward to follow!

Life changing!. For years, my husband had been using the Down Dog app and I did not use it with him. I always said yoga is boring but in late 2023 I ended up having a spinal fusion at S1 -L5 and for about a year after the surgery, I did some movement, stretching some basic Pilates, but I didn’t really get into a program that I just followed until February of last year. I decided it was time to turn my life around! Since then I have lost a good bit of weight & I now use the Down Dog app typically five times a week sometimes more along with a kettlebell workout 3 days a week. All of this together, including the yoga and Pilates has built up my core, legs, glutes and arms significantly and my back pain is pretty much nonexistent! Even after this weekend where I’ve spent the entire weekend lifting and packing up my house to move!
Вы крутые. Очень нужное приложение
The perfect yoga app. This app provides the most customizable practice you can imagine. Wish I found it years ago. So glad they use real music not ai-generated. Don’t change anything! Ever!
Love it!. Wonderful yoga lessons! I love it!
Love this app. Such great yoga and love the music that goes along with it.
Excellent app!. Best yoga practice because so customizable.

Ten years. I’ve been using this app as long as I can remember. Sometimes 6 days in a row to alleviate a tight Tband. Sometimes once a month or once a week to supplement my gym program. Sometimes I’m having babies and I can only work out at home. I have given this app to more people than any other. It is a core of my persona health program.

My favorite yoga app!. I have been using this app for years to practice yoga. I love that you can customize your workout to your level, area or concern, and amount of time. The recent update is amazing and I have been sharing with all of my friends! I am a teacher and have the free version. Thank you Down Dog!

Worth it. So many options with the Pilates, prenatal, barre, yoga, etc. and all the boost modifiers like focusing on hip flexors, etc. As a stay at home mom, this app is so helpful for fitting in a workout when I can, ensuring I get what I need out of it in however much time I have. I found this app when it was much simpler and I was in college and it was free. I was initially upset when it went to paid but it’s well worth the price and the creators deserve the earnings for such a genuinely good app.
Amazing. Never disappointed with the workout!!

Amazing. I’ve had a subscription to this and the other companion apps for years and years. It just keeps getting better. I used to be a yoga instructor and I love that I can customize my practice for how I feel each time. A great app for beginners and long time practitioners. ❤️❤️
Great yoga app. Very adaptable and great for yoga while traveling.

Music. Would prefer not having Chinese music 
Much prefer Indian instruments

Best Yoga App Ever. I’ve had Down Dog Yoga for years, and while I haven’t always been good at doing it regularly, I never have to worry about being too out of practice. The level of customization you can do is absolutely amazing and never leaves me feeling confused or left behind. They give you tips and assure you if you can’t quite do the complete pose.

From the type of yoga (there are so many!), the length of the practice, the voice, the music, even the actor. You can favorite poses, dislike poses. Save practices. Pick areas of the body to focus on. 

Highly recommend for any level of yoga practice. From beginner to expert, it’s amazing.

I do not recommend this yoga app.. I don’t recommend this app for the simple fact that it does not listen. I’ve been using it for two months and it’s stretched only my hips. No matter how much I have tried to program stretches that target the arms and chest and shoulders, this app gives nothing but hips and quads. In a 30 min practice with chest and shoulders as the focus we did zero chest or shoulder stretches, hips and quads only. So then I programmed a 5 min only chest and shoulders and it did one stretches for my triceps and then straight back to a quad stretch for the remainder of the practice. Use a different app that will actually listen to you and your body, not whatever it wants.
Great. I have enjoyed the yoga and the Pilates for almost a year now. So many settings to make this perfect for my daily needs!
Love it. Love how much you can customize. Best yoga/pilates/meditation app out there for sure!

Best Yoga App EVER. I have been using this app since 2021 since it came out. It has been life changing for me. I always thought yoga was useless until I started using this app regularly. As someone who is an athlete and works out daily this app is essential for any athlete looking to improve performance. Cant recommend it enough.

EFFECTIVE! Never gets boring!. I bought this app several years ago and have been using it on average three to four times a week since then. The music and instruction are calming, and the sequences are thorough and never repeat. I have NEVER experienced the boredom of doing the same workout over and over. My flexibility has gone through the roof, and the nagging pain I would experience from doing training for Ultras went away. I now push Yoga on anyone suffering from injuries (“Let me guess, you’re going to tell me to start doing yoga.”). And in my next breath I always push Down Dog as the solution to not wanting to pay exorbitant fees at the yoga studio to experience yoga’s benefits. This is, without a doubt, the best app I’ve ever purchased. I hope I can use it for the rest of my days. Do yoga. Use this app. You will not regret it.

Best Yoga App Ever. I’ve been using Down Dog daily for years and I’m still obsessed with it. It’s hands down the best yoga app I’ve ever used. I love how customizable every practice is, from the length and difficulty to the pace, focus, voice, and music. The music is always great, and I love that I can create exactly the flow I want depending on how I’m feeling that day. I’ve tried other yoga apps, but nothing compares. I genuinely use this app every day and couldn’t recommend it more!

5 year subscriber. Thought it was the best app 5 years ago for yoga, but somehow they continued to improve it so much that I prefer this app yoga over anything else out there. The customization for the sessions is a life saver!

Very simple and fun to use!. Im really enjoying Down Dog, this app offers me everything I need to maintain my mental and physical health on my own at home! Easy levels set up, challenges with reminders, calendar tracking and I appreciate the different exercises available within the same workouts! I’m down with down dog 😄
Oxygen. It’s like oxygen you can’t live without :)

THE BEST. I have never written a review for an app ever, but I just had to come on here because I have never loved an app so much. I have used Down Dog almost every day for the last six years and it has been my anchor. Thank you so much.

Best yoga app. I’ve tried many different yoga apps and this is by far the best. It allows you to customize it to your personal needs. You can favorite poses you like so they show up more often and you can mark ones that you don’t like so they never show up in your session. It has options for the very beginner to the advanced and with so many different styles to choose from there is definitely sitting for everyone.
The best. My favorite app!!

Beginner. Just completed 2 sessions and highly enjoyed both. Love the options with the music and the voice and what you want to work on. I do believe 99.00 is way too much for an app. I will enjoy the month free

Great customer support! All around awesome app!. Recently, I had an issue with my internet connection and my daily session didn’t upload, so my streak had reverted to zero. I contacted customer support as soon as I realized. 
They were quick to respond, recommended steps going forward, and fixed the issue to my utmost satisfaction. 
Thank you Down Dog!
Long time user and lover of this app. Thank you for proving my loyalty again!

Downloaded and didn’t use. Unknown to me I was automatically enrolled in auto renewal. I haven’t used the app in months. I asked for a refund and immediately received it. 

Now for the app itself. It’s good, it does offer lots of options I’m just not a yoga person.
Helped me reinvent myself. I start my day at 4:00a with an hour of Yin. Best hour of my day!
👏. Incredible quality!!
A constant practice opportunity!. Good practices and functionality. My go to when I cannot get to an in person class.
What happened to the quirky??. Love the app but miss the quirky motivational messages. I love the aesthetics but bring back the quirky.
too many side planks. why?. too many side planks. 3 sets in 25 min session?

Love it so far. 2nd practice in, I can finally practice yoga at home, this app keeps me moving, I don’t seem to need the energy of a class to push myself.

Update like 1.5 years later - still love this app

Perfect. Down Dog is the perfect yoga app. This app is so good. Loving the incremental improvements and attention to detail I see, over time. Even that little star-shaped loading spinner feels polished.

One feature request: I often go to in-person classes, now, and on other days use this app. I’d love if I could log offline sessions in the app, to record stats about my practice in general and participate in the Down Dog challenges. Thanks!

Awesome as always. Been using this App for many years. It continues to surprise me with new poses and new sequences. I love the adjustability of difficulty and ability to focus on or ignore certain types of poses. A rare app that has felt perfect for so long.
the best yoga app. I’ve used it for years, keep coming back to it. Keep up the great, easy & calming user experience.

Great app!. I really enjoy this - two years ago, I was training for a triathlon but having trouble tying my shoes on a ski trip I was so stiff and have been using this ever since. Constantly changing routines that really help limber you up. Highly recommend this!

Disappointed. I’ve been paying for this app for several years. Now I can’t use it because I need an iOS update that my iPad is too old for. My iPad is in pristine condition and it seems like it’s just a money racket to continue updating when there is nothing wrong with what I have. The economy sucks and most people don’t have money to go out and buy new phones that cost in the thousands. I’ll finish my time on my iPhone which is only 2 years old but will be extinct in another year. Sorry to cancel my upcoming subscription but I feel like I’m being taken advantage of: The phone company, the down dog standards of having to have the upgrade to use what I already paid for! The oligarchs of the world! Downdog should Do better!
AMAZING!!!. “Hands down” the best Yoga app on the market!!

Awesome. I have been using this app for 6 years now and I have to say this is an incredible app. Super customizable practices: you set the duration, type of practice, and target areas “boosts”, and more.

This app is great if the thought of doing yoga for first time in a studio feels intimidating and you’d rather get some experience with the poses and practices. Also good if you’re intermediate and want to keep growing.

And they keep constantly updating the app and the experience!
Love it. My daily companion for 5+ years!

6 years strong!!. I love this app. I had no idea what I was doing when I first started and now I’ve gotten to a point where I don’t need to watch the videos anymore, just listen. The voice instructions are clear and easy to understand. My hip and back pain are just about non existent now. I pay the subscription and it’s worth it for me. Highly recommend!

worth every penny. I paid the $60 for the yearly membership to use the app everyday and I love it!!! Best yoga classes I’ve attended!! I chose advanced and am happy with how each class really works you into the poses and every muscle. I’ve spent far more on classes irl and gotten less. I also like that it tracks how often I’m keeping up with my classes and lets me save my favorites. 10/10 recommend

I love this app. I have been using Down Dog consistently for at least eight years now. I love the variety, flexibility, and how much I can personalize it to fit my needs. I am totally happy with the interface and can’t imagine ever wanting to choose an alternative app for my at-home yoga practice. Thank you for providing such a great app!!
The best. The best yoga app ever! Affordable and high quality. I love how the practice changes with each session.
Still one of the best yoga apps!. Have loved using this yoga app for years! I hope they can bring back their guided intervals running app too, that was also the best.

Somatic yoga is incredible. Give yourself a pat on the back you guys have made an absolutely incredible app. I love all the different types of yoga you guys have, especially recently the somatic yoga. You’ve done such an excellent job. You should be proud of yourselves. Thank you!

Perfect. "This yoga app is fantastic for both relaxation and getting a good workout. It really helps me unwind after a long day, and I always feel like I've broken a good sweat by the end of a session!"
Love this app. I love how you can personalize each practice to focus on what your body needs in that moment! But please stop asking me to rate it after every practice!
Decline over time. This app is actually getting worse. With each upgrade there are less useful features. Definitely not renewing subscription.
Great for everyone!. This app is simple to use and is great for everyone, beginners to advanced.
Vahe. Best app ever for your mind peace
Dig it.. It’s good! I really look forward to using this app and getting my yoga on.

Convenient great app for yoga practice. I use the app almost every day, to start my day. I can choose how long I want to practice, and which “boost” I want to add, based on my activities planned for the day. Ive been using this app since 2018 and love that they’ve also added Pilates and Core, which I’ve now added into my exercise rotation. Thank you, Down Dog, for making quality practices easy to access.
Great app. Such a versatile platform for my busy morning routine. I can adjust the time, intensity, and complexity to fit my day.

10/10 app. Down dog is truly one of my all time FAVORITE apps on my phone - I’ve been using this app for 7 years now and am continually impressed by its features. I love the yoga practices and how you can adapt the time of your practice, as well as how you can select a specific type of practice focus (e.g. hip stretches, aerobic, core strength, etc.). I also have been using the sleep meditation for months and it has been incredible to help me fall asleep. I couldn’t recommend this app more!
Yayy. I needed this- I’ve had a very bad flu and this helped me!!

Hands down best yoga app. Ive had this app since 2020 and it has been an absolute gift. It kept me centered through my moms near-death COVID infection, a PhD, and many other major life changes. There were some years I only practiced a handful of times, and others I practiced nearly daily. Whatever I was going through, this app has always been a constant and I am so grateful to its developers! It has also only gotten better with features over the years. I love that you can choose boosts, different types of yoga, paces, etc. Definitely worth a download and purchase!

Perfect App to get yoga in. I think yoga is really good for you but it can be hard to find the time and money. This app makes it affordable and easy to squeeze in 10-20 min sessions to keep me flexible.

Amazing app!. I have been using this app for years and absolutely love it. The different flows each time and different options make me want to get on my app each time. I can’t say enough how much I love this app. I recommend it to all yogis-advanced to beginners. It’s the best🩵
Tradesman. I’m a diesel mechanic by trade and know little about yoga lingo. This app is fantastic for a good stretch after a 12 hour shift.
Great for at home yoga!. I have been using this app for years. Love the timer and the videos and the styles of yoga. Well worth the money.
Thank you. This is the best app ever thank you for it I am truly grateful for it.
Flexibility and Flexit. The app is great. You can dialup the exact type of practice you need with so many options.

The calmness during all storms. I’ve been using this app for a while. Yoga is necessary for my mental health. It’s given me the protection to navigate stressful situations. I hope you may find balance and healing. Namaste
Down dog. lie down dog. It’s very comfortable and the instructor has a lot of good details.
Me encanta. Me gusta la cantidad de opciones que tiene, desde tipos de yoga, que estirar, que reforzar, tipo de música, tipo de voz y ahora hasta de modelo.

Everything I could ask for in a fitness app. It’s amazing to me that all the different fitness apps (HIIT, yoga, Barre, etc.) are all included under one very reasonable subscription. Down Dog really is the full package.

Helped me change my life. I started this app in 2020 to help me keep sane during lockdown and I haven’t ever looked back. It has helped me so much to be able to have an accessible form of yoga right at home. It’s always been affordable, and it’s very customizable to be whatever you need it to be. Sometimes if I’m going through a time when it’s really difficult to come to the mat, it’s so great that I can set it for 10 or
15 minutes to make it more accessible during those times. I highly recommend this. I genuinely believe it helped me start to change my life for the better 6 years ago.
A big fan. I’m a big fan of DownDog and recommended it to many of my friends and workmates. The ability to customize workouts for time or injury is my favorite aspect of the app.
Best Yoga App. I have been using Down Dog for more than 6 years, and they have the most complete and flexible routine

Such a wonderful yoga app. I cannot express how much this app has helped me continue my yoga practice. With a busy life that just does not provide the time needed to go to a yoga studio any longer, this app has allowed me to keep doing yoga at my convenience. I love it.
Customizable. Great programs that let me modify to target what hurts (because at 40 sleeping makes me sore) every morning.

Truly Excellent.. The reviews don't lie. I've been using this for over 5 years and find its simplicity and ease of use awesome. That said, it has powerful tools to customize your practice. Just download and try for yourself. You won't regret it!
too fast. Flow is too fast and can’t get set for next activity

Best Yoga App!. I have tried many yoga apps but this is the best one I have used . Have been since for the last 7 years ! Love it !

My favorite app. I love this app! If has enabled me to continue yoga even though I don’t have time to get to a studio at this stage of my life. It’s easy to use, and the ability to customize your practice is fantastic. Highly recommended.
Toooo expensive !. Pro went up $50. Not worth it
New Mobile Interface looks great. This is the next step when you’re tired of sorting through YouTube videos
My go to. This is one powerful app. This is the only app that I reach for when I need a good stretch and recovery. I have been using this for over 4 years and worth every penny.
My go to!. This app is great at home or for travel! I can modify accordingly based on what kind of day I’m having and time. I can include or exclude certain poses or muscle groups.

Always recommend. Whenever anyone asks me what I do for exercise, I always tell them about Down Dog. The fact you can customize, start at your own pace and progress through levels without duplication of sessions is incredible. Dislike one voice-choose another. Feel like upbeat music this time-go for it. Switch to restorative when not feeling well, increase intensity, HIIT, Pilates - anything you want! Just move, stretch, balance and breathe!
Great app. Best yoga app ever you can customize your stretches and time for your preferences

Best yoga app out there. I normally don’t wright reviews, but I thought this app really deserves one. 
Perfect for all levels, clean and simple to use. I highly recommend it!

Обожаю это приложение всей душой. Здесь есть возможность подстроить все под себя от музыки до стиля занятия и поз! Я люблю делать шоу по утрам и меня радует, что есть возможность выбрать длительность занятия. В общем, все настраивается, удобно работает и создает прекрасную атмосферу. Спасибо создателям! ❤️
Best yoga and medication app. By far my favorite app for health! The meditation feature is the best and I love that you can exclude yoga positions you dislike for your practices.
Amazing App. I absolutely love this app. The only thing it’s missing is a strength training program.

For Everyone. I’ve been using Down Dog for a lil over a year. I LOVE that you can do any kind of yoga with a time you can fit in to your busy schedule. I am so grateful someone recommend me to download this app and I have regretted it. 
I would love more challenges to get a T-shirt 🧘‍♂️🧘🏽‍♀️
Best yoga app out there. I have now loved this app for almost 10 years. I loved it then, and I love it now. It never fails to create a practice that brings peace and alignment.

Long time user. This app is fantastic! So many options, variations and levels. I don’t have to sort through a million YouTube videos / advertisements or finding the right “personality” in a video. 
Fantastic, easy to use and accessible!

Absolute best. As a Psych NP I recommend this app to all my clients. Wonderfully customizable and tailored to one’s personal preferences. We have been using since COVID hit and we are never disappointed.

Group Subscription. Love DD and recent changes good except for now not saving configurations of members when on a group subscription. Having to reset them every time is dissuasive at best, highly annoying mostly.

Game changer. June 2026 Update: Ugh I still love this app so much and use it almost daily - sometimes more than once daily. I believe it’s been almost a decade of use. Love the latest updates! My faves are still yoga nidra, vinyasa, gentle and restorative. Sometimes hatha. Fiona is my favorite voice. Thanks for continuing to grow and excel, Down Dog!

June 2022 Update: Still loooovvvvveee this app. Been using for years now. They have added more options, more poses, more styles. I love it all. Pro tip: yoga nidra option for a mid day nap. Or when you have trouble at night falling asleep. I use yoga nidra every day for that. And I use either “full practice” or hatha or ashtanga for usually 30 min every day as well. I keep it on slow mode, with least instruction plus breath. Thank you!

Update: the updates are amazing!!!! Falling in even more love with this wonderful app. Still hoping for prenatal, although now I’m due in a week and I’ve been able to make due with modifications and mostly the Gentle, slow setting. Love the added poses and variations. Can’t wait until I have ability post partum to try out the Ashtanga etc. Thank you so much! I love this app. I’ve been using it multiple times a week since I got it more than a year ago. I’m along time practitioner, and also taught yoga for 8 years in the past. So I don’t need an app to know what to do on my own on the mat, and yet this makes it so that I am practicing way more frequently than ever before, because it is so convenient and I don’t have to think about it. Since I’d consider myself a power user, I do have lots of suggestions for the developer of the app, but the main thing is that I wish they would add more poses! I usually only set the practice for 20-30 minutes and although I don’t mind getting the same poses over again, after a while I start thinking of lots of poses I never get to do that are common to find in any flow class and yet never come up on the app. So that’s my main suggestion.
